title: NVIDIA Debloated Driver Injection
description: Builds a debloated NVIDIA display driver with NVCleanstall and prepares it for offline injection into a Tiny11 Core-Gaming ISO. Mirrors the exact component selection and Installation Tweaks shown in the reference screenshots (NVCleanstall v1.19.0). The primary path drives the NVCleanstall GUI; if that fails, a deterministic fallback downloads the official NVIDIA package, prunes it to the Display Driver, applies the same tweaks as INF edits and re-signs it.
author: kelexine (https://github.com/kelexine)

components.note: Everything except Display Driver (required) is unchecked, matching the reference screenshot exactly.

signing.subject: CN=Tiny11 NVIDIA Driver Rebuild
signing.note: The tweaks below modify the INF, so NVIDIA's catalog signature no longer matches. The rebuilt driver is re-signed with a locally generated certificate; that certificate is trusted inside the image so the driver loads without the unsigned-driver prompt.

injection.note: Drivers are added to the offline install.wim DriverStore before WinSxS optimization so PnP installs them during OOBE.

gui.note: Best-effort control-message automation of the NVCleanstall v1.19.0 wizard. DISABLED by default: on a clean machine NVCleanstall's first page expects a driver that it downloads through its own wizard, and its component/tweak pages are owner-drawn VCL controls that cannot be verified from CI. Set enabled=true (or pass -Method gui) to try it; any failure still falls through to the deterministic fallback.
